Explanation of the change:

1. We pull in the `ol.layer.VectorRenderType` constant so that we can specify `IMAGE` mode on the overlay vector layer.
2. We add `renderMode: ol.layer.VectorRenderType.IMAGE` when constructing the draw-overlay. This causes OpenLayers to render the overlay as a single pre‐composed image (via an intermediate canvas), rather than re‐drawing every feature on each frame, restoring the interactivity performance seen in 4.4.x.
